items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: opposite the stage over there was a wall, ceiling to floor mirror. So that we could watch Jake Hanna’s hi-hat.

ctx.x: Yes. Because the gentleman who started this whole project, the Hamilton graduate, talked about going there. The band would be in a straight line and boy, you have to listen really hard and listen in a different fashion.

Yeah. And you better know it. It was a different fashion. And the opposite side of the room, it was a long room, not terribly wide okay? So the far — opposite the stage over there was a wall, ceiling to floor mirror. So that we could watch Jake Hanna’s hi-hat. You know what I mean?
